title: How Early to Send an ACH Top-Up Before Paying QR Codes Abroad
summary: Picture a mamak counter in Bangsar. The roti canai arrives, the teh tarik is still frothing, and the uncle points at a DuitNow QR sticker taped to the glass.
body_markdown:
Picture a mamak counter in Bangsar. The roti canai arrives, the teh tarik is still frothing, and the uncle points at a[DuitNow QR](https://moretapay.com/networks/duitnow) sticker taped to the glass. You open your wallet and the balance reads zero. The ACH you sent from your hotel on Friday night is still moving between your bank and the wallet.


Send a US bank (ACH) top-up at least three US business days before your first QR payment abroad. Count only weekdays that are not US bank holidays. Moreta, the Y Combinator-backed wallet that pays local QR networks such as DuitNow in Malaysia,[KHQR](https://moretapay.com/networks/khqr) in Cambodia,[Pix](https://moretapay.com/networks/pix) in Brazil and[WeChat Pay](https://moretapay.com/networks/wechat-pay) in China, lists bank account (USD) top-ups at 1-3 business days on its fee page. The practical rule is to fund the bulk of the trip by ACH before you fly. Keep an instant card or Apple Pay top-up in reserve for the day the timing goes wrong.


## How long does an ACH transfer take to reach a travel wallet?


Moreta reports an ACH transfer time of 1-3 business days for US bank account top-ups. That window is where most first-morning payment problems begin.


Nothing is broken. ACH is not built for instant arrival. Card networks authorize payments in real time, while ACH payments are collected and exchanged between banks in batches and then settled.


## Why does ACH settlement time depend on the calendar rather than the clock?


ACH settlement time is measured in business days because the batches only run on banking days. It works like a mail van that empties a post box at fixed times. If you drop your letter just after the last pickup, it waits for the next run. Three things widen that gap for travelers:


- **Weekends.**


A top-up started on Saturday does not begin moving until Monday.


- **US bank holidays.**


They count as non-business days even when every shop in Penang is open.


- **Time zones.**


At 9 a.m. Monday in Kuala Lumpur, it is still Sunday evening on the US East Coast. Travelers in Asia lose most of a day before the US banking week starts. Travelers in São Paulo or Lima sit close to US hours and lose far less.


So how long ACH takes depends less on the hour you tap send and more on which banking days follow it.


## How many days before my trip should I send an ACH top-up?


Aim for at least three US business days before your first payment, and send it before you board. Here is the worst case of Moreta's 1-3 business day window:


Swipe for more


You send the top-up (US time) Plan for funds by Calendar days waited


Monday Thursday 3


Friday Wednesday 5


Saturday or Sunday Thursday 4-5


Friday before a Monday US holiday Thursday 6


The last row is why a week before departure is the comfortable default. It also argues against topping up from the airport gate. If the money is not in the app before you fly, assume day one runs on a backup method.


## Is ACH vs wire transfer or a card top-up the better way to fund a trip?


ACH wins on cost and loses on speed.


The ACH vs wire transfer debate matters less here than people expect. Wires are not on Moreta's list of top-up methods. The real trade-off is speed against cost, based on Moreta's fee page:


Swipe for more


Top-up method Speed (Moreta reports) Fee (Moreta reports)

Two points follow from this table:


- **The waiting problem is mostly an American one.**


European and UK travelers usually see their funds instantly.


- **The backup has a real cost.**


A 500 USD emergency card top-up costs 12.50 USD. The same amount by ACH costs nothing.


Money added with USDC or USDT can't be spent in Cambodia or China, so plan a bank or card top-up for those countries. Availability also depends on your country, the payment method and the app version.


## What happens once the top-up lands and you scan a QR code?


Once the ACH settles, the payment itself is instant, because local rails such as Pix settle immediately and the merchant is paid in local currency. The slow part of getting money into the wallet is settling between your bank and the app, not paying with it. To pay:


1. Open Moreta Pay and tap Scan.


2. Point the camera at the merchant's QR code, such as the DuitNow standee at a nasi kandar shop in George Town.


3. Check the review screen for the merchant name, the amount in ringgit, the FX rate and the fee.


4. Slide to confirm, and keep the receipt that appears in the app.


China works the other way around. Pay opens on your own payment code for the cashier to scan, and it only works while you are physically in China.


QR coverage is wide, but it is not total. Keep a modest cash reserve, such as a few 10 MYR notes for a cash-only car park or pasar malam stall, or some 10 BRL notes in Brazil. If an ATM or card terminal offers to charge you in US dollars, decline. Always choose to be charged in local currency, because dynamic currency conversion lets the machine's operator set the exchange rate.


## What should I set up before I board?


Pulling the timing logic together, the routine fits in three steps:


- **Ten days out:**


download the app and verify your identity with a selfie and your passport.


- **Seven days out:**


link a USD bank account through Plaid and send the ACH top-up for the bulk of the trip.


- **Before boarding:**


confirm the balance has landed, and keep a card or Apple Pay ready as an instant backup.


## Frequently Asked Questions


### **Can an ACH top-up reach my wallet faster than three business days?**


Don't plan around it. Moreta lists US bank account top-ups at 1-3 business days, so build your schedule on three. If you need money today, use a card, Apple Pay or Google Pay.


### **Does topping up early lock in worse travel money exchange rates?**


No. Your balance converts at the live rate at the moment you pay, and the review screen shows that rate before you confirm. Moreta's fee page lists a 1.5% fee per payment with no markup hidden in the rate.


### **How long does ACH take if I send it on a Friday?**


Plan for Wednesday at the latest. If the Monday is a US bank holiday, plan for Thursday.


### **Can I fund from a European, UK or Canadian bank?**


Yes. SEPA (EUR) and UK Faster Payments (GBP) usually arrive instantly, and Interac e-Transfer covers CAD.


### **Is there a spending limit after I top up?**


Each country has a single-payment maximum and a weekly limit, both shown in the app. Moreta lists 12,000 MYR per payment and 24,000 MYR per week for Malaysia. For Brazil, the limits are 16,000 BRL per payment and 32,000 BRL per week.


### **Which countries can I pay in?**


Moreta's rails include:


- DuitNow QR in Malaysia


- KHQR in Cambodia


- Pix in Brazil


- WeChat Pay in China


- [QR Ph](https://moretapay.com/networks/qr-ph) in the Philippines


- [Seoul Pay](https://moretapay.com/networks/seoulpay) in South Korea


- [Yape](https://moretapay.com/networks/yape) and[Plin](https://moretapay.com/networks/plin) in Peru


- [Bre-B](https://moretapay.com/networks/bre-b) in Colombia
